source: in-client screenshot, manually transcribed. Support role only — the capture shows one role.
notes: DECISIVE — this is the first observed banner where a PREFIX and a SUFFIX fire on the same map, which docs/SCORING.md §5 had explicitly left unresolved.

Game 3 (8946285985) qualifies for both: Потойбічний +7% (both supports on pool heroes 85 and 26) and Вирішайло +16% (last possible game of a 3-game series). Solving the map multiplier from each emblem independently gives 1.229999 / 1.230000 / 1.230004 — i.e. exactly 1.23.
1 + 0.16 + 0.07 = 1.23 ADDITIVE. The multiplicative reading (1.07 x 1.16 = 1.2412) overshoots every emblem by ~0.36% and is REFUTED.
Game 1 (8946161660) carries multiplier exactly 1.0: neither support was on a pool hero and it is not the decider. That pins the pair as well as the stacking.

Counted maps are games 1 and 3 of the GamerLegion series, NOT the TEAM VISION series. Under both the real emblem set and the smokes variant, GamerLegion is the higher-scoring series in our data, so any engine selecting TEAM VISION here has a selection bug.

Independent corroboration: the same additive model scores the TEAM VISION pair at exactly 15384.11, which is the support observedTotal recorded in banner-observation-sersergiy.json from an earlier day.

SUPERSEDED ON THE DIVIDE: banner-observation-madstone-pair proves displayed emblems are UNDIVIDED (its core teamfight would need 5.21 of a possible 4.0 otherwise). The three emblem numbers transcribed here sum exactly to Очки, which the undivided reading cannot produce, so they should be re-read from the original capture. The additive-stacking conclusion is unaffected: it is a ratio between the two counted maps and does not depend on the absolute scale.
